issues.what: a paper-thin stray triangular polygon stretches across the outer corner of the headlamp cavity, intersecting directly through the lit DRL spur in set-B-03.png, while the upper headlamp brow breaks into jagged sawtooth polygons
issues.fix: delete the stray intersecting triangle, rebuild the headlamp opening with clean quad loops and real sheet-metal return thickness, and model the DRL as separate lens geometry in its own housing

issues.what: both rear corners of the hood crease below the windshield have jagged mesh tears and dark pinched holes that break zebra stripe continuity in set-F-15.png
issues.fix: retopologize the hood and cowl as separate panels with clean supporting edge loops and an even shutline gap

issues.what: the rear underbody reads as an un-assembled hollow shell: missing wheelhouse liners leave the upper rear tires exposed inside an empty void beneath a thin bumper skirt, and a primitive rectangular box with honeycomb sliced mid-cell at its 90-degree corner (set-D-09.png) sits atop flat slab diffuser fins
issues.fix: add full rear inner fender liners, replace the stamped box with a framed mesh grille recessed into a housing, and model the diffuser with real wall thickness, fillets, and mounting joins

issues.what: the windshield, roof, A-pillars, cowl, hood, fenders, and front bumper are one continuous connected mesh; zebra stripes wrap across beveled steps from glass to body with no separate glass pane, rubber seal, cowl vent, wipers, or front hood and bumper shutlines
issues.fix: split the windshield glass, weatherstripping, cowl, wipers, hood, fenders, and front bumper into separate geometry with rolled panel thickness and real joins

issues.what: panel seams are shallow V-grooves indented into a single continuous surface rather than open gaps between separate panels with edge thickness, with water droplets sitting inside the groove and the rear quarter seam in set-D-09.png dead-ending abruptly at the taillight
issues.fix: cut body panels into distinct shells with rolled return flanges and maintain an even-width physical gap along the full perimeter of every panel

issues.what: the side mirror stalk is a bare tube that intersects directly into the door skin and mirror housing without a mounting base, collar, or gasket, causing severe zebra pinching on the door in set-F-04.png
issues.fix: model the mirror base, gasket, stalk, and cap as separate parts meeting at a recessed door mount with a real join and no self-intersection

issues.what: both front and rear tires intersect and clip flat into the ground plane with a sharp horizontal cut edge instead of flattening slightly with a natural sidewall contact bulge
issues.fix: place the tires tangent to the deck and deform the contact patch with a subtle flat spot and lower-sidewall bulge so nothing intersects the ground

issues.what: zebra reflections break across raw diagonal triangulation creases splitting the rear diffuser bays corner to corner, with similar flat-triangle facets and X-pinched quads under the taillights (set-F-09.png) and around the front bumper DRL and intake (set-F-13.png)
issues.fix: rebuild the diffuser, rear fascia, and front bumper with clean quad topology, support loops, and smooth normals so zebra stripes flow without kinks or triangle breaks

issues.what: curved silhouettes break into straight polygon segments with visible vertices along the rear haunch arch, the upper windshield roofline (set-F-05.png), the macro panel silhouette (set-E-02.png upper left), and the wheel arch lips (set-D-02.png center), which also terminate in an abrupt square step
issues.fix: increase subdivision density along all curved body silhouettes and wheel arches so curves hold up at macro distance, and blend the wheel-arch lip smoothly into the rocker

issues.what: the four exhaust pipes are thin-walled open cylinders floating inside flat-backed hexagonal pockets with no internal pipework join, and the narrow bridge between the two hexagonal bezels has pinched, kinked bevels
issues.fix: give the exhaust tips rolled-edge wall thickness, connect them to recessed exhaust piping, and clean up the bevel topology between the dual surrounds

issues.what: the concrete parking wheel-stop block and storm-drain grates are miniature relative to the car (roughly 20 to 30 cm long, narrower than a single tire), and the grates sit as raised plates on top of the pavement casting an edge shadow (set-D-02.png lower right) rather than sitting flush
issues.fix: scale wheel stops and drain grates to real-world dimensions relative to the vehicle and recess each grate flush into a framed deck opening

issues.what: the small trapezoidal pocket on the rear haunch above the side intake has pinched corners and wobbling zebra stripes instead of a separate filler door or vent insert with an even shutline
issues.fix: model the filler door or vent insert as separate geometry with clean corner fillets and an even perimeter gap
